column1: # M-Vsynth2's words for the screen reader (fm1-reader): the screen's text <TAB> what is said.
# tools/gen_words.py firmware/words.tsv docs/words firmware/gen/ann_words.h  (tests/run_unit.sh runs it)
# -> docs/words/<id>.json (published with the pages; never change or delete one: a device points at its own)
#    firmware/gen/ann_words.h (the link the device sends). Whole words, capitals ignored, the longest match wins;
# "#" takes a number and says it, "*" takes a word and leaves it out. The common ones (FX, ENV, LFO, RES, ...) are
# gen_words.py's; an entry here says one differently. Check: sh tests/run_speak.sh
# ---- the values (VS_CHOICE, VS_LFO_SYNC, VS_ARP_BEAT, VS_DLY_TIME, vs_param_text)
